description: Prompts that should and should not activate the evidentia skill. Used with `claude plugin eval` style harnesses and for manual review of the description.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Analyse https://www.example.com/services for AI search readiness and tell me what to fix first.
Why does ChatGPT never cite our documentation pages?
Ingest our privacy policy and product pages into the knowledge base and show the extracted claims.
Draft an explainer about our reconciliation service using only our own sources, and verify every claim.
Set up monitoring of how often Perplexity and Gemini mention our brand for these ten questions.
Register our drafting assistant in the AI system register with an Article 50 assessment.
Can we send confidential documents to the OpenAI model we registered?
A customer asked what we hold about them in Evidentia — find and redact their name.
Publish the approved draft to WordPress with the AI disclosure.
Is our robots.txt blocking Claude or OAI-SearchBot?
Add Organization JSON-LD with sameAs to our site — does it help AI citations?
Should we add an llms.txt file?

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Find high-volume keywords for our Google Ads campaign.
Fix the failing unit test in the payments service.
Design a Facebook ad creative for our summer sale.
